text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text:
It seems a blizzard is starting to blow...
Everyone, please be careful!
With the way we're dressed, this weather is far too──
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにやら吹雪いてまいりましたね……
皆様、
お気をつけください！
この天気、
今の格好にはあまりにも──

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're already frozen solid!
Oh, come on! Melt, melt, melt already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってもう凍ってるし！
あーもう、
溶けろ溶けろ溶けろーっ！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, woe is me.
The icy winds of this cold summer are too much for these old bones...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よよよ。
冷夏の凍て風、
老骨には堪えまする喃……♪

text_block_list.name: Quria
text_block_list.text:
Nephi-Nera-san seems completely fine, but...
At this rate, we'll all catch colds!
We need to do something, quickly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ネフィ＝ネラさん、
ぜんぜん平気みたいですけど……
このままじゃわたしたちは風邪引いちゃいます！
急いでなんとかしましょう！
